comment: The expected Netflix titles mosaic (docs/spec-0.1.md section 11): what a clean build of pattern.yaml from the tessera it pins gives, per target. knowledge_hash is section 3.6, vector_hash section 3.7, embed_model the model of section 6. Recorded from two clean local builds; these values are the contract, so a change to them needs a reason. The knowledge hash and the model are exact. vector_hash is the reference build's: another processor may differ in a few bits (ADR-005), so a build's vectors are compared with expected-vectors.json.
